description: Source code for the HttpAuthHandler class, implementing HTTP authentication handling logic including challenge initialization, token generation, and challenge response handling within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandler
classes.description: Class responsible for handling HTTP authentication, including challenge initialization, token generation, and challenge response.

methods.name: InitFromChallenge
methods.description: Initializes the handler from an authentication challenge, setting up necessary parameters and logging the process.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an authentication token based on provided credentials and request, handling asynchronous callback.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Indicates whether the handler needs an identity for authentication.

methods.name: AllowsDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Indicates whether default credentials are allowed.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Indicates whether explicit credentials are allowed.

methods.name: OnGenerateAuthTokenComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of auth token generation.

methods.name: FinishGenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Finalizes the token generation process, logging the result.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallenge
methods.description: Handles a new challenge after an initial one, logging the result.
